page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core and 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA instruction sets. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing is weak, as demonstrated by stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression benchmarks, which fall into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core performance is average, with stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores all landing in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth remains average for both small and large block reads, though the overall PassMark memory score is weak.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this server is configured for compute-focused tasks that can leverage parallel processing across its 12 physical cores. It is suitable for multi-threaded batch processing, basic database operations, and moderate Redis workloads, where it achieves average transaction rates. The lack of local storage and lower single-core performance represent key tradeoffs, positioning this instance as a cost-efficient option for legacy multi-threaded workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or modern AVX-512 VNNI vector instructions.
